label: Найти
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for найти (to find).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person perfective future. 'Найду' is the 1sg future of perfective найти, built with prefix на- on the future stem найд-. Perfective verbs lack a present tense, so this form means 'I will find'.

Strategic focus: Second-person future. 'Найдёшь' is the 2sg future of найти, end-stressed on the ё, which must be typed exactly. The imperfective partner находить describes finding repeatedly or in progress.
Strategic focus: Third-person future. 'Найдёт' is the 3sg future of найти. The prefix на- adds completion, so the sentence promises a single successful result of the search.
Strategic focus: First-person plural future. 'Найдём' is the 1pl future of найти, end-stressed. 'Решение' is the direct object in the accusative, naming what will be found.
Strategic focus: Polite/plural future. 'Найдёте' is the 2pl future of найти. 'За углом' uses за + instrumental for location 'around the corner'. The ё stays stressed across this stem.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural future. 'Найдут' is the 3pl future, completing the future scaffold of найти. Note the future stem найд- across all six persons.
Strategic focus: Suppletive masculine past. 'Нашёл' switches to the irregular past root наш-, with no д. It is the masculine past of найти and reports a completed discovery.

missions.phrase: Она нашла старое письмо в ящике.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Suppletive feminine past. 'Нашла' uses the irregular наш- past root, marking a female subject. Past tense agrees in gender, not person.
Strategic focus: Suppletive plural past. 'Нашли' is the plural past of найти on the наш- root, sharing nothing with the future stem найд-. This closes the past series.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Найди' is the informal command from найти, asking for a single act of finding. The imperfective partner находить would frame the search as ongoing.
